body:
That power-hungry, attention-seeking, try-hard mod locked my "Who Will Be the Next Owner?" topic. https://avicus.net/forums/8c9ddba4b


He locked it because "this isn't really necessary." Please, like all the other "Who Will Be"'s are necessary. I demand that it be unlocked and/or Snow demoted. That, or lock every single topic that is actually useful to the forums, aka every single one. You might want to re-asses the re-assed mods. Abuse of power like this is ridiculous.
